paras: Trachylepis cristinae, also known commonly as the Abd al Kuri skink, is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Yemen.
The specific name, cristinae, is in honor of herpetologist Cristina Grieco, who was one of the collectors of the holotype.
T. cristinae is found on the island of Abd al Kuri in Yemen.
T. cristinae may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 11.5 cm (4.5 in).
